note: Coordinates are offset by about 500 m by Landrace.wiki; some mark a settlement or district.

properties.name: 4000 Islands
properties.description: Growing area in the Mekong island reach of Khong District, Champasak Province, Laos, with six landrace accessions from one site.

properties.name: Achinsk forest-steppe
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the island forest-steppe round Achinsk and Bogotol, where wild hemp grows by roads, villages and farms and overgrows fallow and sown fields.

properties.name: Afram Plains
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Afram plains of Ghana's Eastern Region, between the Afram River and Volta Lake, one of the newer growing areas of the 1990s, where an 80-hectare cannabis farm was found in a forest reserve in 2022.

properties.name: Ahmednagar
properties.description: The licensed ganja-growing tract of the Bombay Presidency, in the Nagar taluka from 1917

properties.name: Akto
properties.description: Cannabis growing area of the oasis strip of Akto County, Xinjiang, where police found cannabis grown in maize fields and courtyards in 2023 and 2024.

properties.name: Alipurduar
properties.description: Growing area in The Dooars on Alipurduar District, the eastern part of the Western Duars; its appellations are the old duars, blocks and forest tracts

properties.name: Analabe
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the mountains of Ambanja District, Diana Region, northern Madagascar, round the rural commune of Antsahabe and the Tsaratanana massif.
properties.climate: Humid; highly variable and often rainy

properties.name: Angul
properties.description: Angul District, where ganja was grown on homestead land in the 1890s and where police have destroyed cannabis on forest land every year since at least 2014

properties.name: Antri
properties.description: Districts of northern Madhya Pradesh where the Gwalior State's ganja was grown in three tahsils in the 1890s and where police found ganja fields in 2025

properties.name: Araku Valley
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the agency hill country of Alluri Sitharama Raju District, the former Visakhapatnam agency, in the Eastern Ghats of Andhra Pradesh

properties.name: Argolis
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the regional unit of Argolis, where the earliest sources place hashish growing in Greece in the 1870s; police uprooted 387 plants in a coastal forest area in 2024.

properties.name: Ariari
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Ariari region of Meta, where marijuana was planted around the Serranía de La Macarena in the 1970s and has been eradicated in Lejanías since 2010.

properties.name: Artux
properties.description: Cannabis growing area of the oasis plain of Artux City, Xinjiang, where police uprooted cannabis grown in a maize field at Suntagh in 2022.

properties.name: Attappadi
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the forests of Attappadi, Palakkad District, Kerala, on the Tamil Nadu border

properties.name: Ayadaw
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Ayadaw Township and on its border with Myinmu, southern Sagaing Region, Myanmar, where villages turned from rice, beans, betel nut and cotton to cannabis from 2022–23.
properties.climate: Semi-arid; annual rainfall under 25 inches (635 mm)

properties.name: Balkh
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Balkh Province, northern Afghanistan, where the UNODC cannabis surveys of 2009 to 2012 recorded commercial cultivation each year.

properties.name: Ban Phaeng
properties.description: Growing area in Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom, Thailand, with two landrace accessions from points 12.5 km apart on the Mekong terraces.

properties.name: Barwani
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Barwani District, south of the Narmada in western Madhya Pradesh

properties.name: Bashkir Trans-Urals
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the east of Bashkortostan, where weedy hemp grows in cereal crops and wild hemp on abandoned fields.

properties.name: Beni Zeroual
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the country of the Beni Zeroual, a Jebala tribe of the Rif foothills north of Fez, round the town of Ghafsai in Taounate Province, Morocco.

properties.name: Beqaa Valley
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Bekaa valley of eastern Lebanon, between the Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon ranges, where cannabis was grown for hashish round Zahle and Ras Baalbek by 1933 and is still grown in Baalbek and Hermel districts.
properties.climate: Drier than the coast, with a wider range of temperature

properties.name: Betroka
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Betroka District, Anosy Region, southern Madagascar, round the mountains of Andriry near the town of Betroka.

properties.name: Beutong Ateuh
properties.description: Mountain cannabis growing area in Beutong Ateuh Banggalang district, Nagan Raya, Aceh, where police and army operations found and destroyed fields of up to 50 hectares in 2023, 2025 and 2026.

properties.name: Bhimbar
properties.description: A tract of wild hemp on the Jammu border of Gujrat, whose bhang was exported for sale into other districts in the 1890s; flora studies recorded the plant there again in 2019–2022

properties.name: Bhopawar
properties.description: Districts of south-western Madhya Pradesh where hemp was grown for ganja and bhang across the Bhopawar Agency in the 1890s and where police have raided cannabis fields since 2022

properties.name: Bolaven Plateau
properties.description: Upland in southern Laos, east of Pakse, in the Southern Laos growing region.
properties.provinces: Champasak Province, Salavan Province, Sekong Province, Attapeu Province

properties.name: Bolikhamsai
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the eastern districts of Bolikhamsai Province, Laos, where police destroyed fields in Viengthong, Khamkeut and Xaychamphone in 2021 and 2022.

properties.name: Bortala
properties.description: Border prefecture of north-western Xinjiang where the border force clears stands of wild cannabis every summer and autumn.

properties.name: Brahmaputra chars
properties.description: River islands and sandbars of the Brahmaputra in Assam where the police destroyed cannabis between 2021 and 2026

properties.name: Bukhara
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the irrigated oasis of the lower Zarafshan round Bukhara, Uzbekistan, where hemp was grown in the 19th century for oil, the drug bang and rope, and where police found cannabis on house plots in 2026.

properties.name: Bursa
properties.description: Country around Bursa where cannabis was grown for esrar in the 19th century and whose hashish was known abroad as the hashish of Brusa; hemp was still grown on a small scale in 1939

properties.name: Cardamom Mountains
properties.description: Mountain range corridor spanning Koh Kong, Pursat and Kampong Speu provinces and an important landrace cannabis growing area.

properties.name: Central Tuvan Basin
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the central basin of Tuva, on the upper Yenisei and the Khemchik, where weedy hemp grows on abandoned fields, at livestock farms and at herders' camps.

properties.name: Chamarajanagar
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the forest-fringe villages of Chamarajanagar District, Karnataka, on the Tamil Nadu and Kerala borders

properties.name: Chamoli
properties.description: Growing area in Chamoli District, Uttarakhand, with landrace accessions collected at Niti, 3,600 m, and Lambagad, 2,037 to 2,400 m.

properties.name: Champasak
properties.description: Growing area on the Mekong lowland of Champasak Province, Laos, with accessions from Pakse District and Champasak District.

properties.name: Changzhi
properties.description: Hemp district of south-eastern Shanxi, known for its Lu hemp (潞麻), where seed of four hemp landraces was collected in 2020.

properties.name: Chefchaouen
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Chefchaouen Province in the western Rif Mountains of Morocco, the province with the largest area under cannabis in the 2004 and 2005 national surveys.

properties.name: Chengdu Plain
properties.description: Districts of the Chengdu Plain, Sichuan, where true hemp (Cannabis sativa) was grown extensively for fibre in the early 20th century.

properties.name: Chitral
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Chitral valleys of the Hindu Kush, in northern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, with the Yarkhun Valley appellation.

properties.name: Chittagong Hill Tracts
properties.description: Cannabis grown in the remote hills of the three hill districts, where police and the army have destroyed fields since 2019

properties.name: Chom Thong
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Chom Thong District, Chiang Mai Province, on Doi Inthanon and in the Op Luang hills, where herbarium sheets show cannabis grown in a Hmong plantation and a home garden.

properties.name: Chu Valley
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the valley of the Chu (Shu) river in Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan, where wild cannabis covers tens of thousands of hectares and is harvested for marijuana and hashish.

properties.name: Chumbi Valley
properties.description: Valley of Yadong County, Tibet, between Sikkim and Bhutan, where a feral population was sampled for a genome study published in 2026.

properties.name: Châu Đốc
properties.description: Area of An Giang Province, Vietnam, where Marie Alexandrine Martin reported in 1973 that cultivation was important.

properties.name: Dan Chang
properties.description: Landrace cannabis growing area in Dan Chang District, Suphan Buri Province, with one accession, a general population from the 2021 harvest.

properties.name: Darma Valley
properties.description: Growing area in the Darma valley, Dharchula Block, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand, with three accessions collected at Sosa and Tanta between 3,470 and 3,740 m.

properties.name: Demoso
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Demoso Township, Kayah State, Myanmar, where the owner of a dispensary under the protection of a resistance force said in 2023 that he was growing cannabis on about 100 acres.

properties.name: Dir
properties.description: Historical cannabis growing area in the mountains and valleys of Dir, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, named in 1985 among the places in Pakistan where cannabis was mainly cultivated.

properties.name: Doi Chiang Dao
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Chiang Dao District, Chiang Mai Province, where a licensed farm has grown cannabis in greenhouses since 2021.

properties.name: Doi Langka
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on Doi Langka in northern Thailand, where Hmong people grew hemp for weaving in 1933.

properties.name: Doi Suthep–Pui
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the Doi Suthep and Doi Pui massif west of Chiang Mai, where a landrace cultivar was grown at Doi Pui and Hmong weavers grow hemp.

properties.name: Doi Yao–Doi Pha Mon
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Thoeng District, Chiang Rai Province, around the Doi Yao and Doi Pha Mon hills, where Hmong villagers weave hemp.

properties.name: Dolpa
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Dolpa District, north-west Nepal, where the Magars of the 1970s grew cannabis for the oil pressed from its seed.

properties.name: Dêqên
properties.description: Tibetan autonomous prefecture of north-western Yunnan, where hemp was grown above the Yangtze in 1911, the Naxi of Baidi use hemp seed for oil and the police cleared wild cannabis at Xiaruo in 2025 and 2026.

properties.name: Edo
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Edo State, Nigeria, along the border with Ondo State, where the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency reports destroying cannabis farms in the forests of Owan West, Owan East, Ovia North-East and Ovia South-West.

properties.name: Ereğli
properties.description: Kaza of the Konya vilayet whose villagers planted 1,300 dönüm with cannabis for esrar under the name of hemp after the Ottoman ban on sowing

properties.name: Fatehgarh
properties.description: Districts on the Ganges where hemp was grown as a field crop for bhang, sold as Fatehgarh bhang, in the 1880s and 1890s

properties.name: Ganja Mahal
properties.description: The licensed ganja-growing tract of the Bengal Presidency round Naogaon, in what is now Naogaon District, Bangladesh. Growing ended in 1987.

properties.name: Garo Hills
properties.description: Cannabis plots at Kuligoan and Bhoiragopi in South West Garo Hills, destroyed by the Border Security Force with the police and district officials in 2018 and 2020.

properties.name: Gayo Lues
properties.description: Mountain cannabis growing area inside the Gunung Leuser protected forest in Gayo Lues regency, Aceh, where 51.75 hectares were destroyed in 2025 and an estimated 26.5 hectares in 2026.

properties.name: Ghomara
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the Mediterranean slopes of Chefchaouen Province in the Rif Mountains of Morocco, the country of the Ghomara tribes, where many families grow cannabis.

properties.name: Gilgit
properties.description: Cannabis growing area round the town of Gilgit, on the south bank of the Gilgit river in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, where Indian hemp was among the field crops in 1891

properties.name: Gori Valley
properties.description: Growing area in the lower valley of the Goriganga, from Munsyari down to Jauljibi, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand, with nine accessions collected at Munsyari, Harkot, Madkote, Sera, Bata and Bona between 1,200 and 2,500 m.

properties.name: Gourara
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Gourara oases of the Algerian Sahara, round Timimoun, where kif was grown by 1721 and where the gendarmerie found cannabis and opium poppy in oasis gardens at Aougrout, Talmine and Tinerkouk in 2007.

properties.name: Gwassi Hills
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Gwassi Hills of Suba South, Homa Bay County, near Lake Victoria, named in 1999 among the reputed sources of good-quality bhang, where officials uprooted cannabis from the hill forest in 2024.

properties.name: Gyalrong
properties.description: Valleys of the upper Dadu in western Sichuan, where travellers between the 1890s and 1908 saw hemp grown by Tibetan and Chinese farmers; a hemp landrace was collected at Xiaojin in 2020.

properties.name: Gyirong Valley
properties.description: Himalayan valley of Gyirong County, Tibet, where wild cannabis has been sampled for genome studies and where Tibetans and the Daman use the bark of the plant for rope and tools and feed it to cattle.

properties.name: Gümüşhacıköy
properties.description: Hemp district of Amasya, producing about 500 tonnes a year in 1939; its farmers' rope and seed were marketed by a cooperative from 1970, and hemp was sown there again under contract in 2025

properties.name: Haouz
properties.description: Plain and Atlas valleys round Marrakesh where kif was grown on irrigated land in the early twentieth century and for the protectorate's tobacco and kif monopoly, and where fibre hemp was grown into the 1960s

properties.name: Heilongjiang
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Heilongjiang Province of China, where cannabis grows as an invasive wild plant and industrial hemp is grown for fibre, flowers and leaves.

properties.name: Helmand
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Helmand Province, southern Afghanistan, where the UNODC cannabis surveys of 2009 to 2012 recorded commercial cultivation each year.

properties.name: Hhohho
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Hhohho Region, in the mountainous north of Eswatini round Piggs Peak, where smallholders grow cannabis as a cash crop.

properties.name: Hispar Valley
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the upper valley of the Hispar River, in Nagar District of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, where a seed collection was made in 2023.

properties.name: Hohoe
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Hohoe Municipal District in the Volta Region of Ghana, where police destroyed cannabis farms in 2007, 2009 and 2015 and where 14 cannabis growers were interviewed for a study in 2024.

properties.name: Hopar Valley
properties.description: Cannabis growing area at the villages of Hopar beside the Bualtar Glacier, in Nagar District of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, where a seed collection was made in 2022.

properties.name: Hunza
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Hunza District, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan; hemp seed used as a source of oil reached the United States Department of Agriculture in 1974, and seed of a charas landrace reached the United States genebank in 2024

properties.name: Idukki
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the hills of Idukki District, Kerala, known for the ganja sold as Idukki Gold

properties.name: Ili Valley
properties.description: Valley of the Ili in Xinjiang, where wild cannabis grows in woodland, fields and roadsides and the police clear stands every summer.

properties.name: Issyk-Kul
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Issyk-Kul Region of Kyrgyzstan, where wild cannabis grows in the valleys and on abandoned fields and villagers rub hashish from it by hand.

properties.name: Jaintia Hills
properties.description: The hills of the Syntengs, where ganja grew in 1893 and from which hill ganja was taken down to Sylhet.

properties.name: Jalal-Abad
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Jalal-Abad Region of Kyrgyzstan, where wild cannabis is gathered and burned in raids and cannabis is grown on household plots and pastures.

properties.name: Jalori
properties.description: Slopes on both sides of the Jalori ridge around the Jalori Pass in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, between the Jibhi Gad and the Ani Gad, documented as a landrace cannabis growing area from a Coco Genes accession from the village of Mahoot.
properties.climate: Temperate, sub-alpine and alpine; heavy snow from December to March

properties.name: Jalpaiguri Dooars
properties.description: Growing area in The Dooars on Jalpaiguri District east of the Teesta; its appellations are the old duars, blocks and forests

properties.name: Jamuna chars
properties.description: River islands and sandbars of the Brahmaputra–Jamuna in Bangladesh where the police seized cannabis in 2022 and 2024
properties.provinces: Rajshahi Division, Dhaka Division, Rangpur Division, Mymensingh Division

properties.name: Johar Valley
properties.description: Upper valley of the Goriganga above Munsyari, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand, with accessions from Saimut and the upper-valley villages of Martoli, Burphu, Bilju and Panchhu between 1,384 and 3,360 m.

properties.name: Jomotshangkha
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Jomotshangkha sub-district of Samdrup Jongkhar, Bhutan, where villagers of Lauri and Serthig gewogs harvest the wild plant and dry it for sale across the border.

properties.name: Kadavu Island
properties.description: Island in Fiji's Eastern Division where police have seized cannabis since at least 2018, uprooting 82,700 plants from the province between January 2020 and March 2021.

properties.name: Kalat
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Kalat District, central Balochistan. Hemp was grown for bhang and charas at Kalat and Iskalku in the Kalat State at the end of the 19th century. Standing crops of bhang were destroyed at Pandran, Khadi and in the Mangochar sub-division in 2023 and 2025.

properties.name: Kali Valley
properties.description: Growing area in the Kali valley, Dharchula Block, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand, where seven of eight accessions are feral selections.

properties.name: Kampot
properties.description: Growing area covering Kampot Province, Cambodia, from the Damrei Mountains around Bokor to the inland hills of Chhuk and Chum Kiri districts.

properties.name: Kandahar
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Kandahar Province, southern Afghanistan, where the UNODC cannabis surveys of 2009 to 2012 recorded commercial cultivation each year.

properties.name: Karategin
properties.description: Valley of the Surkhob in Tajikistan, the former bekdom of Karategin, where hemp was grown on irrigated land in the 1890s.
properties.climate: Continental; long winters with much snow, hot summers of about two months

properties.name: Karo Plateau
properties.description: Volcanic highland plateau in Karo regency, North Sumatra, where police found small cannabis plots among food crops in seven districts between 2022 and 2026, and where a cannabis specimen was collected near Berastagi in 1919.

properties.name: Kashgar
properties.description: Cannabis growing area of the Kashgar oasis, Xinjiang, which with Yengi Hissar supplied charas to British India in the nineteenth century and where the police found cannabis grown among maize in 2015.

properties.name: Kashmir Valley
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Kashmir Valley, where wild hemp was cut under a State lease in the 19th century and cannabis is grown in fields, orchards and forest today

properties.name: Khammouane
properties.description: Khammouane Province, Laos, where ganja growing around Thakhek increased in the 1980s.

properties.name: Khandwa
properties.description: The licensed ganja-growing tract of the Central Provinces in the Khandwa tahsil of the Nimar district

properties.name: Khasi Hills
properties.description: Cannabis grown in courtyards, backyards and fields at Laitlulong, in the Sohiong area of East Khasi Hills, destroyed by the police in 2025.

properties.name: Khotan
properties.description: Cannabis growing area of the Khotan oases, Xinjiang, named in 1881 as a source of the charas brought into India, where border police uprooted more than 30,000 plants in 2008–09.

properties.name: Kibungan
properties.description: Mountain area on the disputed boundary of Kibungan and Sugpon, with Kayapa in Bakun, where cannabis plantations have been destroyed since 2017.

properties.name: Ko Phangan
properties.description: Growing area on the island of Ko Phangan, Surat Thani Province, Thailand, with nine hybrid accessions from one inland site.

properties.name: Ko Tao
properties.description: Growing area on the island of Ko Tao, Surat Thani Province, Thailand, with eighteen hybrid selections from one grower.

properties.name: Koh Anlong Chen
properties.description: Island in the Bassac River, Kandal Province, where villagers grew cannabis with their vegetables and police destroyed the plantations in December 1996.

properties.name: Koh Kapik
properties.description: Commune of mangrove islands in Koh Kong Province, Cambodia, whose villages of Koh Kapik and Koh Sralao grew cannabis in the 1980s.

properties.name: Kolai-Palas
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Kolai and Palas valleys of Kolai-Palas District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, where police destroyed cannabis cultivated at Bin Banda in 2019 and at Kolai in 2025.

properties.name: Kolar
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the old Kolar district of Mysore, now Kolar and Chikkaballapur districts, Karnataka

properties.name: Kongpo
properties.description: Country of the Tsangpo and Nyang valleys in Nyingchi, Tibet, where wild and feral cannabis has been sampled for genome studies and cleared by the police; a herbarium sheet was gathered there in 1947.

properties.name: Koraput
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Koraput District, southern Odisha, on the Andhra Pradesh border

properties.name: Kullu Valley
properties.description: Main valley of the Beas in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, documented as a landrace cannabis growing area from the villages of Rumsu, Pulag and Hallan on its Chanderkhani side; the Parvati and Malana valleys are documented separately.

properties.name: Kyaukse
properties.description: Kyaukse District, Mandalay Region, Myanmar, where officials reported ganja grown illicitly in the 1880s and 1890s.

properties.name: Kyzylorda
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Kyzylorda Region of Kazakhstan, where cannabis is sown on hidden plots in the steppe and desert and in house yards.

properties.name: Küçük Menderes Valley
properties.description: River valley inland from İzmir whose towns of Ödemiş and Tire grew hemp in the 19th and 20th centuries; still sown there in 1995

properties.name: Lan Mát
properties.description: Place in northern Vietnam, known from two herbarium sheets of cultivated plants collected by Henri François Bon in 1883 and 1884.

properties.name: Liangshan
properties.description: Yi autonomous prefecture of south-western Sichuan, with neighbouring Yanbian, where seed of hemp landraces was collected at Muli, Huili and Yanbian in 2020 and the Miao of Yanbian sow hemp for cloth.

properties.name: Lice
properties.description: Mountain district of Diyarbakır Province, first among the cannabis-growing districts of the province in a police study of 2015, where security-force operations have seized cannabis plants since 2012

properties.name: Lijiang
properties.description: Prefecture-level city of north-western Yunnan, where the Yi of Xiaoliangshan grow hemp, the Naxi grew it for fibre and use its seed, and a sheet of the 1920s records hemp cultivated for fibre for horse ropes.

properties.name: Loralai
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Loralai District, north-eastern Balochistan, where the district administration, police, Levies and the provincial excise department destroyed standing crops of bhang at named villages in 2024 and 2025 and reviewed a survey of cultivation in 2026.

properties.name: Lower Kohistan
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the mountains of Lower Kohistan District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, where police destroyed cannabis grown at Mundraza in 2021, at Saunglan and Heran Kayal in 2024 and in the Dubair area in 2025.

properties.name: Lower Missouri Valley
properties.description: Counties on the Missouri River where hemp was grown for fibre, mostly dew-retted and sold for cotton bagging and bale rope, from about 1835 until about 1890

properties.name: Lu Thaw
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in northern Kayin State, Myanmar, where, according to the Karen National Union, villagers displaced by the army began growing cannabis around 2011.

properties.name: Lu'an
properties.description: Hemp district of the Pi River at Lu'an, Anhui, whose local hemp, hanma, is among the landraces of China's hemp crop; 1,305 hectares were sown in 2019.

properties.name: Madaya
properties.description: Madaya Township, Mandalay Region, Myanmar, where hemp grown round houses was found and stopped by the district administration in 1891.

properties.name: Mae Chan
properties.description: Mae Chan District, Chiang Rai Province, where the hill village of Ban Huai Kang Pla once grew cannabis among its household vegetables.

properties.name: Mae Rim
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Mae Rim District, Chiang Mai Province, where Hmong households grow hemp for cloth and herbarium sheets show cannabis cultivated in 1977 and 1996.

properties.name: Mae Taeng
properties.description: Mae Taeng District, Chiang Mai Province, where herbarium sheets of 1997 show cannabis planted among corn near a Red Lahu village.

properties.name: Mahadeva
properties.description: Barabanki district, where ganja was cultivated until the district authorities forbade it, some years before 1893

properties.name: Malana Valley
properties.description: Valley of the Malana torrent, which joins the Parvati at Jari in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, documented as a landrace cannabis growing area from the village of Malana and the hamlets of Nirang, Wailing, Atolang and Waichin; the Parvati Valley is documented separately.
properties.climate: Cold for most of the year, with a long snowy winter

properties.name: Manipur Hills
properties.description: Ganja grown in the hill districts of Manipur, in Ukhrul for decades, sown in June and July and harvested in December and January.

properties.name: Mantineia
properties.description: Cannabis growing area round Tripoli in Arcadia, the province of Mantineia, where most Greek hashish was grown before cultivation was banned in 1920; police found a plantation of 1,253 plants in Tripoli municipality in 2024.

properties.name: Meiktila
properties.description: Meiktila District, Mandalay Region, Myanmar, where officials reported the hemp plant grown in gardens in the 1890s, after it had been prohibited.

properties.name: Mergui
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Tenasserim, Lenya and Maliwun tracts of the old Mergui district, Tanintharyi Region, Myanmar, where hemp was grown for smoking before the prohibition of the 1870s and marijuana plants were destroyed in 2018.

properties.name: Messenia
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the regional unit of Messenia, where police uprooted more than 10,500 plants between 2017 and 2019, most of them on Taygetos and in Triphylia.

properties.name: Mikir Hills
properties.description: Hills of Karbi Anglong, where farmers feed hemp leaves to pigs and where an 1893 excise survey placed one of Assam's ganja-producing hill tracts

properties.name: Mizo Hills
properties.description: The Lushai country of 1893, which the Commissioner of Excise for Assam counted among the hill tracts that produced ganja.

properties.name: Mokhotlong
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Mokhotlong District, in the north-eastern mountains of Lesotho, whose eastern part the Basotho count among the sources of their first-grade cannabis.

properties.name: Mount Kenya forest
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the forest of Mount Kenya within Meru, Tharaka-Nithi and Embu counties, where an aerial survey of 1999 counted about 200 hectares of cannabis fields on the south-eastern slopes.
properties.climate: Two rainy seasons; the south-eastern slopes, facing the winds from the Indian Ocean, are the wettest

properties.name: Mount Meru
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the slopes of Mount Meru in Arumeru District, Arusha Region, northern Tanzania, where the Drug Control and Enforcement Authority destroyed farms at Kisimiri Juu and around the foot of the mountain in 2023.

properties.name: Mpondoland
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Eastern Mpondoland round Lusikisiki and Port St Johns, on the Wild Coast of the Eastern Cape, where cannabis has been grown in the valleys for over a century.
properties.climate: Summer rainfall; rain-fed cropping possible, though poor soils limit it

properties.name: Muang Sing
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Sing District, Luang Namtha Province, Laos, the source of a seed line sold as Lao Highland.

properties.name: Mvomero
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Mvomero District, Morogoro Region, eastern Tanzania, where the Drug Control and Enforcement Authority destroyed 603 acres of cannabis farms in four villages in August 2026.

properties.name: Myelat
properties.description: South-western Shan State, Myanmar, the Myelat states between the Burmese plains and the Shan States, where Danu villagers were said in the 1890s to grow a few plants each for their own use.

properties.name: Mylopotamos
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the northern slopes of Psiloritis, where police reported cannabis plots in the municipalities of Mylopotamos and Anogeia in 2017 and in each year from 2020 to 2026.

properties.name: Naga Hills
properties.description: Cannabis destroyed at Kiphire in 2017 and on the Dhansiri in Peren district in 2018; in 1893 ganja was said to grow profusely in the Naga Hills.

properties.name: Nakhon Si Thammarat
properties.description: Growing area covering Nakhon Si Thammarat Province, Thailand, with six appellations on the slopes and foothills of the Khao Luang range.

properties.name: Nam Ou Valley
properties.description: Growing area on the Nam Ou at Nong Khiaw, Luang Prabang Province, Laos, with one landrace accession at 350 m.

properties.name: Nangarhar
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Nangarhar Province, eastern Afghanistan, where the UNODC cannabis surveys of 2009 to 2012 recorded commercial cultivation each year and later fieldwork found it in the districts below the Spin Ghar.

properties.name: Naryn
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Naryn Region of Kyrgyzstan, where wild cannabis is gathered and mowed in raids and cannabis is grown on household plots.

properties.name: Natewa Peninsula
properties.description: Peninsula in Cakaudrove province on the south-east of Vanua Levu, Fiji, where police destroyed more than 47,000 cannabis plants in four operations in 2026 in districts they call the Golden Triangle.

properties.name: Nkhotakota
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Nkhotakota District, central Malawi, where large-scale growing was reported along the Lupache river in 2003 and fields have since been destroyed inside the district's wildlife and forest reserves.

properties.name: Northern Cauca
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the western slopes of the Central Cordillera in the north of Cauca, where marijuana is grown in the open and under lit greenhouses in five municipalities.

properties.name: Nujiang
properties.description: Lisu autonomous prefecture on the upper Salween in north-western Yunnan, where hemp was grown and woven in the 1910s, hemp cloth was paid in tribute in 1730 and border police cleared about 1,200 wild plants at Gudeng in 2015.

properties.name: Oksibil
properties.description: Highland valley around Oksibil, the seat of Pegunungan Bintang regency in Highland Papua, where army border task forces and police destroyed cannabis grown in gardens and forest five times between September 2025 and October 2026.

properties.name: Ondo
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Ondo State, south-western Nigeria, where the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency reports destroying cannabis farms in forests and forest reserves.

properties.name: Osh
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Osh and Batken regions of southern Kyrgyzstan, where wild cannabis was gathered for anasha in the 1980s, the police mow wild stands in summer raids, and cannabis has been found sown on plots.

properties.name: Ouazzane
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Ouazzane Province, northern Morocco, where kif is grown in the communes round Zoumi, Mokrisset and Brikcha. The province lies outside the three in which cannabis may be licensed.

properties.name: Pakke-Kessang
properties.description: Cannabis destroyed near Sede Natung under the Lemmi police station in April 2026; listed as a medicinal plant of the Seijosa circle.

properties.name: Parvati Valley
properties.description: Valley of the Parvati river in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, from its confluence with the Beas at Bhuntar to the Pin Parvati Pass, documented as a landrace cannabis growing area from Grahan, Pulgi, Thunja, Rasol, Tosh, Lapas and Gohar; the Malana valley, a side valley, is documented separately.
properties.climate: Temperate montane; generally cool and dry, with monsoon rain

properties.name: Patkai Bum
properties.description: Hill district below the Patkai range on the Myanmar border, where poppy and cannabis grown at Bordumsa were destroyed in 2021

properties.name: Phop Phra
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Phop Phra District, Tak Province, where Hmong farmers of Khiri Rat grow hemp from their own seed for cloth.

properties.name: Pindar Valley
properties.description: Growing area in the Pindar valley, Kapkot Block, Bageshwar District, Uttarakhand, with cultivated and feral cannabis collected at six villages between 1,900 and 2,413 m.

properties.name: Pishin
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Pishin District, north-western Balochistan, where the district administration, the excise department, the Frontier Corps and the police destroyed crops of bhang at Kali Manzarai, Kali Malikyar and in the outskirts of Pishin in November and December 2025.

properties.name: Poshina
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Poshina taluka, in the north of Sabarkantha District, Gujarat

properties.name: Provincia de Ocaña
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the Provincia de Ocaña, the western subregion of Norte de Santander, where marijuana plantations were reported near Ocaña and in Ábrego in 2014–2016 and marijuana was eradicated in five municipalities between 2012 and 2018.

properties.name: Punakha
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Punakha District, Bhutan, where the police report abundant wild growth in three gewogs and outsiders come to harvest the plant.

properties.name: Putao
properties.description: The plain round Putao and the hills east and north of it in northern Kachin State, Myanmar, where the Rawang grow hemp, which they call Azi, for the thread of their clothes.

properties.name: Qila Abdullah
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Qila Abdullah District, north-western Balochistan, where the provincial excise department, the district administration and the Frontier Corps destroyed cannabis crops at Dobandi, Gulistan Karez and Sagai in 2025 and ran a further campaign in October 2026.

properties.name: Qingshui County
properties.description: County of eastern Gansu where hemp has traditionally been grown and which Xinhua called a core hemp-growing area of the province and the country in 2026.

properties.name: Quindío
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the department of Quindío, where a landrace population of Punto Rojo was grown near Calarcá in 2023 and cannabis is grown under licence for medicinal use.

properties.name: Radom
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Radom locality, in the south of South Darfur State in Sudan, which Sudanese police have called the country's main area for growing bango since 2012; a field study of 1994 dated the growing there to the 1940s.

properties.name: Sa Pa
properties.description: Growing area around Sa Pa, Lào Cai Province, Vietnam, with a herbarium specimen of 1913 and a fibre population collected at Tả Phìn in 2023.

properties.name: Sadanga
properties.description: Barangays Saclit and Betwagan in Sadanga, Mountain Province, where police and drug agents have destroyed cannabis plantations at Mount Churyon, Sitio Paras, Mount Chalimuno and Mount Makago-ong.

properties.name: Sagaing
properties.description: Sagaing District, Sagaing Region, Myanmar, where officials reported Burmans growing ganja for sale in the 1890s, after it had been prohibited.

properties.name: Samarkand
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Samarkand Region, Uzbekistan, on the middle Zarafshan, where hemp was among the irrigated crops in 1900 and where police found cannabis sown in a field in 2021 and in a yard in 2026.

properties.name: Samoeng
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Samoeng District, Chiang Mai Province, home of the Pang Da Royal Agricultural Station's hemp plantings.

properties.name: Sangkhlaburi
properties.description: Growing area at Kroeng Krawia in Sangkhlaburi District, Kanchanaburi, Thailand.

properties.name: Santol
properties.description: Municipality of La Union where, the United States Department of State reported, marijuana was grown openly for 40 years, with plantations destroyed at Sabsaba, Sapdaan and Tubaday.

properties.name: Satara
properties.description: The licensed ganja-growing tract of the Satara district of the Bombay Presidency, centred on the village of Lengre in the Khanapur taluka

properties.name: Saur Valley
properties.description: Growing area in the Saur valley, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand, with four landrace accessions collected between 1,517 and 1,638 m.

properties.name: Sekong
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Sekong Province, Laos, holding the Dak Cheung appellation.

properties.name: Serranía del Perijá
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the Colombian side of the Serranía del Perijá, where marijuana crops were established by the late 1970s and where marijuana was eradicated in its municipalities between 2007 and 2020.

properties.name: Seulimeum
properties.description: Upland kecamatan of Aceh Besar where cannabis fields have been destroyed at Desa Pulo, Lampanah and Lambada repeatedly since 2023.

properties.name: Shashamane
properties.description: Cannabis growing area around the town of Shashamane in West Arsi Zone, Oromia Region, Ethiopia, where police seized cannabis from farmers in the 1990s, took plants from growing plots in 2013 and destroyed cannabis farms in 2018–19.

properties.name: Shivamogga
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the forests and farmland of Shivamogga District, Karnataka, in the Malnad

properties.name: Si Sawat
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Si Sawat District, Kanchanaburi Province, Thailand, where a Karen villager described cannabis sown among the upland rice.

properties.name: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the slopes of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, where marijuana was grown for Colombia's export boom of the 1970s and where police have destroyed fields since 2000.
properties.provinces: Magdalena Department, Cesar Department, La Guajira Department

properties.name: Sonepur
properties.description: The Sonepur State, where ganja was grown in almost every village until a ban in 1889

properties.name: Souss
properties.description: Valley and foothills of the Souss in south-western Morocco where kif was grown in small plots hidden among vegetables and maize in the early twentieth century
properties.provinces: Taroudant Province, Chtouka Aït Baha Province

properties.name: Sughd
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the northern districts of Sughd Region, Tajikistan, where cannabis has been found sown on plots and wild stands are destroyed every year.

properties.name: Swat
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the mountains and valleys of Swat District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, named in 1985 among the places in Pakistan where cannabis was mainly cultivated; a 2013 survey found it common in the fields of the Miandam valley, where charas is made from it.

properties.name: Tai'an
properties.description: Hemp district of west-central Shandong whose fibre landrace, known as Lai Wu or Fei Cheng hemp, was grown on about 65,000 hectares a year in the 1970s, with escaped and wild cannabis on Tai Shan.

properties.name: Takeo
properties.description: Growing area covering Takeo Province, Cambodia, whose cultivation centres on the Bayong Kor hills of Kirivong district on the Vietnamese border.

properties.name: Talas
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Talas Region of Kyrgyzstan, where wild cannabis is gathered and mowed in raids and cannabis is grown on household plots.

properties.name: Taounate
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Taounate Province on the southern edge of the Rif Mountains of Morocco, where cultivation spread from the central Rif in recent decades.

properties.name: Tarime
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Tarime District, Mara Region, northern Tanzania, where the Drug Control and Enforcement Authority destroyed cannabis farms in 2023, 2024 and 2026.

properties.name: Taşköprü
properties.description: Hemp district of Kastamonu, the main kendir kaza of the Kastamonu tax registers of 1486 and 1560, with 75 hemp villages in 1933; hemp has been sown again since 2020

properties.name: That Phanom
properties.description: Growing area at That Phanom, Nakhon Phanom, Thailand, with four inbred landrace lines collected at one site.

properties.name: Tinglayan
properties.description: Mountain municipality of Kalinga where police have destroyed cannabis plantations at Loccong, Buscalan, Butbut Proper, Ngibat and Tulgao, most of them on Mount Chumanchil.

properties.name: Tirah
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the mountains round the head of the Bara River, in Khyber and Orakzai districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, where cannabis has been grown for hundreds of years and made into charas.
properties.climate: Moderate on Tirah Maidan; semi-arid in Orakzai

properties.name: Tirthan Valley
properties.description: The valley of the Tirthan river in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, from its source in the Great Himalayan National Park to its junction with the Sainj above Larji, documented as a landrace cannabis growing area from a Coco Genes accession from Nadar, in Pekhri.
properties.climate: Western Himalayan temperate and alpine; monsoon rain from mid-June to mid-September; snow in winter

properties.name: Tolima
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the department of Tolima, where marijuana has been eradicated since at least 2007, most of it in the municipalities of Planadas, Chaparral and Rovira.

properties.name: Tor Sihite
properties.description: Hill complex on the boundary of Tambangan and Panyabungan Timur districts in Mandailing Natal, North Sumatra, where hectare-scale cannabis cultivation has been reported and destroyed repeatedly since 2018.

properties.name: Tripura Hills
properties.description: Cannabis grown in forest, hill and government land across Tripura, destroyed in police and border-force drives since 2018.

properties.name: Turkestan (growing area)
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Turkestan Region of Kazakhstan and the city of Shymkent, where cannabis is sown on plots in the steppe, the mountains and the riverside thickets and in house yards.

properties.name: Udawalawe
properties.description: Cannabis growing area on the eastern side of Udawalawe National Park, in Monaragala District of Sri Lanka, with accessions from Kalawelgala and plantations destroyed in the Hambegamuwa forest belt.
properties.climate: Tropical, between the dry and intermediate zones

properties.name: Upper Doab
properties.description: Plain districts at the head of the Ganges–Yamuna Doab where hemp grew wild and was gathered for bhang in the 1880s and 1890s

properties.name: Upper Jaldhaka Valley
properties.description: Narrow Himalayan river valley along the upper Jaldhaka in Kalimpong district, West Bengal, from Jhalong to the Bhutan border, with documented feral and domesticate landrace cannabis populations.

properties.name: Upper Kohistan
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in the mountains of Upper Kohistan District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, where police and the agriculture department destroyed cannabis cultivated in Kandia tehsil and elsewhere in the district in 2020, 2024 and 2026.

properties.name: Vezirköprü
properties.description: Inland district of Samsun Province where 58 farmers grew hemp for fibre and seed in 2018–19

properties.name: Vientiane
properties.description: Growing area in Vientiane Province, Laos, with one landrace seed accession.

properties.name: Virunga National Park
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Virunga National Park, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where cannabis was reported grown in the park's forests by armed groups in 2011 and by Bambuti villagers in 2017.

properties.name: Weining
properties.description: County of north-western Guizhou where seed of a hemp landrace was collected in 2020 and six cannabis plants found by a pupil were cleared in 2026.

properties.name: West Kameng
properties.description: Cannabis cultivation reported in West Kameng District, around Kalaktang in 2026; Monpa and Sherdukpen uses of the plant.

properties.name: Western Pamir
properties.description: Valleys of the western Pamirs, Tajikistan, where Nikolai Vavilov found hemp sown for hashish in 1916.
properties.climate: Dry; fields irrigated from mountain streams

properties.name: Wungchilo
properties.description: Cannabis growing area at Wungchilo in Jamkhar gewog, Trashi Yangtse, Bhutan, a remote site with many cannabis plants where people go to make hashish.

properties.name: Xayaboury
properties.description: Cannabis growing area around the town of Xayaboury, Sainyabuli Province, Laos, with a landrace seed lot from the 2023 harvest.

properties.name: Xining
properties.description: Valleys of north-eastern Qinghai round Xining, where a herbarium sheet of 1908 is labelled cultivated hemp and a genomic study of 2026 sampled feral populations at Huangzhong and Guide.

properties.name: Yahukimo
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Yahukimo Regency, Highland Papua, where army task forces found fields at Kima, Air Garam and Kurima in 2026.

properties.name: Yala-Lunugamvehera
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in and around Yala National Park and the Lunugamvehera reserve, in Monaragala and Hambantota districts of south-eastern Sri Lanka, with accessions from Galge.

properties.name: Yarkand
properties.description: Cannabis growing area of the Yarkand oasis, Xinjiang, the source of the Yarkand charas traded to British India; its counties were still named among Xinjiang's main producing areas in 2015.

properties.name: Zhob
properties.description: Cannabis growing area in Zhob and Qila Saifullah districts, north-eastern Balochistan, where a government fact-finding mission found cannabis fields in 1977 and the district administration listed landowners involved in cultivation in 2025.
